background.title: Background updates
background.question: Collect news in the background?
background.body: If you turn this on, 所闻 installs a background task: even with the window closed it writes today's brief at 7:15 every morning and checks for flashes every 3 hours. It pauses while the Mac sleeps and catches up when it wakes.
background.where: It appears in System Settings → General → Login Items and can be turned off there at any time, or in Settings → Background updates.
background.failed: Couldn't turn it on. You can try again later in Settings → Background updates.

settings.title: Settings
settings.uiLanguageHint: The language of menus and interface text. The language AI writes in is set under AI and language.
settings.readingLanguagesHint: Choose which languages appear in the article list. Languages are detected from the text; articles whose language can't be detected are always shown.
settings.aiIntro: Reading needs no AI. With it connected you get briefs, flashes and developments. Keys stay on this Mac; with cloud AI, the relevant content is sent to the chosen service.
settings.keySaved: Saved; leave empty to keep it
settings.keyHint: Get a key from Google AI Studio. Usage is billed by Google.
settings.defaultModel: Leave empty for the recommended default
settings.fastModelHint: Leave empty for the default or writing model
settings.noVectorHint: Leave empty to use AI pre-screening instead of vectors
settings.ollamaHint: Install and start Ollama on this Mac first. Models run locally; search fill-in isn't available.
settings.outputLanguageHint: For the briefs and developments AI writes. Articles stay in their own language.
settings.searchFillHint: When an important story body cannot be fetched, verify and fill it with the current AI provider's search tool.

settings.sourcesIntro: Subscribe to more social platforms through RSSHub. It's a download of about 63 MB and takes about 370 MB once installed.
settings.instanceHint: Only connect to a server you run or trust. Leave empty to use the local extension. Save after entering it.
settings.instanceFailed: Couldn't save. Check the address and try again.
settings.packIntro: Install it to enable RSSHub subscriptions. Ordinary subscriptions don't need it.
settings.downloadFailed: The download didn't finish, please try again
settings.xIntro: X has no free API, so posts are fetched with Apify's Tweet Scraper: sign up at apify.com and enter your API token here. It's billed per post — about US$0.02 each time an X source updates, charged by Apify. The token stays on this Mac.
settings.backgroundIntro: Keep collecting news after the window is closed. Pauses while the Mac sleeps and catches up when it wakes.
settings.loginItems: It appears in System Settings → General → Login Items, where you can turn it off at any time.

watches.emptyLine2: Write a sentence about something you want to follow, or pick from the topic library.
watches.noAi: AI isn't connected: articles are matched by each watch's keywords, without judging whether they're really relevant, and no developments are written.
